fato_historico: 1894: H. H. Holmes, one of the first modern serial killers, is arrested in Boston, Massachusetts.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a transformative energy to your spirit, Scorpio. Just as the shadows of history eventually give way to the revealing light of truth, you may find it is a good time to uncover hidden strengths within yourself. Consider this a fresh start where your intensity becomes a powerful beacon for personal growth and deep emotional clarity.
frase_do_dia: The brightest light often emerges from the deepest parts of your soul.
significado_numero: Represents infinite flow, personal power, and the cycle of spiritual rebirth.
conselho: Trust your intuition and release anything that no longer serves your beautiful journey.
